data.summary:
**When:** Any phase, after one of your **SHADOW LEGION** units is **destroyed**, before its last model is taken off the battlefield and before any dice are rolled for [Deadly Demise](vsdata:core-ability/deadly-demise).

**Target:** That same **SHADOW LEGION** unit; it can be the target despite being destroyed.

**Effect:** Roll a D6, with +2 to the roll if the unit has **SLAANESH**, for every enemy unit in [Engagement Range](vsdata:core-rule/engagement-range) of the unit's last model. That enemy unit takes D3 [mortal wounds](vsdata:core-rule/mortal-wounds) if its roll is 4-5, or 3 mortal wounds if it is 6+.

window: after destruction, before removing the last model or any Deadly Demise roll

effect.per: enemy unit in Engagement Range of last friendly model
